thesis: Palomar is a profitable specialty P&C insurer with revenue up 58% YoY to 386.6M, net income up 27% with improving earnings growth, and a forward P/E of 13.7. It has held its Nov 5 earnings gap for 6 sessions on fading volume just under the 162.08 52-week high, and as a low-beta (0.24) financials name it sits in a leading sector of a risk-off tape. Price is extended (RSI 70.5, 8.7% above SMA20), so the setup is a pullback-only entry in 155.5-159.0 with zone R/R of about 2.8 (1.9 at the 159.20 last close), not a chase.
invalidation: A daily close below 151.5 (the Nov 6 gap-hold low), with a close under the 20-day SMA near 146.5 confirming the post-earnings breakout has failed.
